name: agent_auth
docs: Interface of the AgentAuth core program AFTER hardening. LOCKED: the 2136-byte layout and every existing offset, the verify ABI (tag 3, 49 bytes) and error codes 1..18. APPENDED: instructions 5..6 and error codes 19..22, and two header bytes taken from the reserved area (version @79, bump @80). Where this file says "target", the implementation must match it; any deviation must be reported and this file updated.
generatedBy: baseline interface read from commit ae67543 (design/tools/gen_artifacts.py) + hardening decisions of 2026-10-10; the core-fix work package owns this file and must keep it equal to the implementation

instructions.name: create_mandate
instructions.dataLengthNote: exactly 9 bytes: tag + i64 expiry (anything else => 15)

args.name: expiry
args.desc: unix timestamp; the FIRST second at which the mandate is invalid (expired iff now >= expiry); must be > now at creation (else 20)

accounts.name: agent
accounts.desc: agent pubkey (any key; not required to sign)

instructions.checks: accounts>=3 else 15; owner signer else 18; owner != agent else 19; data (after tag) == 8 else 15; PDA address match else 16; expiry > now else 20; mandate writable else InvalidAccountData; then by the PDA's current state: owned by AgentAuth => size 2136 and disc 0 (zeroed husk) is initialised in place after a rent top-up, disc 1 => 3, any other size/disc => 16; owned by the System Program => 0 lamports: CreateAccount; lamports > 0 (pre-funded or refunded): Transfer(top-up to rent-exempt) + Assign(AgentAuth, PDA signs) + grow to 2136; non-empty system-owned data => 16; owned by any other program => 14
instructions.writes: whole account zeroed, then disc=1, version=1, bump, owner, agent, expiry, active=1, permissions_len=0. Pre-funded lamports above rent are kept; the owner only tops up the shortfall

instructions.name: add_permission
instructions.dataLengthNote: exactly 50 + 8*disc_len bytes including the tag (anything else => 15)
instructions.checks: accounts>=2 else 15; data (after tag) is exactly 49+8*disc_len bytes else 15; owner signer else 18; mandate.owner==AgentAuth else 14; writable else InvalidAccountData; size 2136, permissions_len<=16 and disc==1 else 16; owner match else 2; active else 4; disc_len==0 else 22; disc_len>8 else 11; duplicate program id else 21; permissions_len==16 else 10

instructions.name: remove_permission

args.name: target_program
args.desc: removes the WHOLE permission slot of that program (all its discriminators)

instructions.checks: accounts>=2 else 15; data (after tag) == 32 else 15; owner signer else 18; mandate.owner==AgentAuth else 14; writable else InvalidAccountData; size/disc else 16; owner match else 2; active else 4; program not found else 12; swap-remove (last slot moves into the hole, tail zeroed)

instructions.name: verify

accounts.name: owner
accounts.desc: must equal mandate.owner (not required to sign)

instructions.checks: data (after tag) == 48 else 15; accounts>=3 else NotEnoughAccountKeys; mandate.owner==AgentAuth else 14; writable else InvalidAccountData; size 2136, permissions_len<=16 and disc==1 else 16; active else 4; now<expiry else 5 (expired iff now >= expiry); owner key else 2; agent key else 17; agent signer else 18; program slot else 6; discriminator else 7; per_tx else 8; lifetime else 9 (a limited permission whose spend_total+amount overflows u64 => 9)
instructions.writes: slot.spend_total += amount; slot.call_count += 1 (saturating for an unlimited permission: verify never reverts because of counter overflow)
instructions.advisory: verify trusts caller-reported program/discriminator/amount and any program can call it: it is advisory unless the integrator makes it a precondition of an action it controls.

instructions.name: revoke_mandate

accounts.name: system_program
accounts.desc: optional: ignored by the current source; the repo test helper passes it

instructions.checks: accounts>=2 else 15; data (after tag) empty else 15; owner signer else 18; mandate.owner==AgentAuth else 14; writable else InvalidAccountData; size/disc else 16; owner match else 2; PDA address verified with the stored bump (version >= 1; legacy version-0 mandates fall back to a bump search) else 16. Works on paused and on expired mandates
instructions.writes: REAL close: all lamports to owner, data zeroed and shrunk to 0 bytes, account assigned back to the System Program (no program-owned husk can remain; the address can be re-funded, even in the same transaction, and re-used by create_mandate)

instructions.name: set_active
instructions.checks: accounts>=2 else 15; data (after tag) is exactly one byte, 0 or 1, else 15; owner signer else 18; mandate.owner==AgentAuth else 14; writable else InvalidAccountData; size/disc else 16; owner match else 2. Does not require the mandate to be active
instructions.writes: header.active = value. Works on paused mandates. While paused, verify => 4 NotActive and add/remove/update => 4. Counters and permissions are preserved. revoke_mandate stays the destructive kill switch.

instructions.name: update_permission

args.name: per_tx_limit
args.desc: new per verify call cap, 0 = unlimited

instructions.checks: accounts>=2 else 15; data (after tag) == 48 else 15; owner signer else 18; mandate.owner==AgentAuth else 14; writable else InvalidAccountData; size/disc else 16; owner match else 2; active else 4; program not found else 12
instructions.writes: slot.spend_limit and slot.per_tx_limit replaced; spend_total, call_count and the discriminator list are PRESERVED (changing a limit does not grant a fresh budget)

fields.name: active
fields.desc: 1 active, 0 paused (set_active). revoke_mandate closes the account instead

fields.name: version
fields.desc: layout/semantics version, 1 for this release (written by create_mandate; 0 on accounts created by the v0.1 binary)

fields.name: bump

errors.name: TooManyDiscriminators

quirks: One permission slot per program id (duplicate add => 21). remove_permission removes the whole slot (all its discriminators); use update_permission to change limits without resetting spend_total/call_count.
spend_limit == 0 and per_tx_limit == 0 mean UNLIMITED (fail-open sentinel kept for layout compatibility). SDK/CLI/dashboard must require an explicit "unlimited" opt-in.

Spend counters are keyed by TARGET PROGRAM and unit-less: every mint/decimal of the SPL Token program shares one raw-unit counter. Hard per-asset budgets need the relay (it pins the mint) or one mandate per asset.

verify trusts the caller-reported program id / discriminator / amount. It is advisory unless the integrator derives those values itself from the action it is about to perform (as the relay does) and gates the action on the result.

Anyone can create a mandate that names any agent with themselves as owner. Integrators MUST bind mandate.owner to the owner of the assets/authority they protect, and MUST hard-code the AgentAuth program id (see crates/agent-auth-cpi).
The mandate has no nonce/created_at: a re-created mandate for the same (owner, agent) has the same address. Consumers (the relay) bind to the stored expiry/bump generation.
Expiry is the first second at which the mandate is invalid (expired iff now >= expiry).

Mandates created by the v0.1 binary (devnet, before the upgrade) have version 0 and no stored bump; revoke_mandate falls back to a bump search for them. They also have no expiry validation, so their expiry may be in the past.

update_permission preserves spend_total: lowering spend_limit below the amount already spent blocks the permission until the owner raises it again (or removes and re-adds it, which resets the counters). On an UNLIMITED permission spend_total saturates at u64::MAX, so setting a finite limit later also blocks it until remove+add.
There is deliberately no instruction to change the expiry: to change a lifetime, revoke and create again (same address, new generation).
